'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Siege of Chernihiv]]
****[[Vyacheslav Chaus]], the [[Governor of Chernihiv Oblast|governor]] of [[Chernihiv Oblast]], says that at least 33 people have been killed and at least 18 others injured in [[Russian Air Force|Russian]] [[airstrike]]s on residential areas in [[Chernihiv]]. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/news-pmn/at-least-22-killed-in-air-strikes-in-ukraines-chernihiv-region-say-emergency-services (''National Post'')] [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2022-03-03/at-least-22-killed-in-air-strikes-in-ukraines-chernihiv-region-say-emergency-services (''U.S. News & World Report'')] [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/russia-ukraine-crisis-33-killed-18-injured-in-russian-strikes-in-ukraines-chernihiv-city-2802547 (NDTV)]
***[[Battle of Kharkiv (2022)|Battle of Kharkiv]]
****Thirteen students are killed at the [[National University of Kharkiv]] after a Russian shell struck a dormitory at the university's Academy of Culture. Five foreign students are among the dead, including four [[China|Chinese]] and one [[India]]n student. [https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/4461836 (''Taiwan News'')]
***[[Battle of Kherson]]
****The [[Ukrainian Navy]] [[Ukrainian patrol vessel Sloviansk|patrol vessel ''Sloviansk'']] is destroyed in a Russian [[anti-ship missile]] strike off the [[Port of Odesa]], resulting in the disappearance of all its crew. [https://defbrief.com/2022/03/06/russia-sinks-island-class-patrol-boat-donated-to-ukraine-by-the-us/ (Debrief)]
***[[Ukrainian refugee crisis]]
****The [[United Nations]] [[United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees|High Commissioner for Refugees]] says that over one million [[Ukrainians]] have fled the country since the invasion began. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/3/3/1-million-refugees-flee-ukraine-in-week-since-russian-invasion (Al Jazeera)]
***[[Reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****[[Russia–United States relations]]
*****Russia and the U.S. establish a [[hotline]] in an effort to prevent escalation between the two [[List of states with nuclear weapons|nuclear powers]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/new-us-russia-military-hotline-ukraine-war-rages-2022-03-03/ (Reuters)]
***[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian Foreign Minister]] [[Sergey Lavrov]] says that [[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|the war]] on [[Ukraine]] will continue "until the end", and accuses [[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] of allowing "a society where [[Nazism]] is flourishing". Lavrov also says that Russia is not planning a [[nuclear warfare|nuclear war]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-lavrov-no-doubt-that-solution-ukraine-crisis-will-be-found-2022-03-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2022 Russian financial crisis]]
**[[Standard & Poor's]] downgrades Russia's debt from BB+ to CCC-, signalling that it believes that Russia is prone to defaulting on its obligations. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/deals/sp-drags-russias-rating-deeper-into-junk-territory-2022-03-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The [[Estonia]]n cargo ship MV ''Helt'' sinks near the [[Port of Odesa]] in the [[Black Sea]] following an explosion. All six crew members on board were rescued, according to authorities. Estonian Foreign Minister [[Eva-Maria Liimets]] says that an investigation into the incident will occur. [https://www.euronews.com/2022/03/03/estonian-owned-cargo-ship-sinks-after-explosion-in-black-sea (Euronews)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in France]]
*****[[Prime Minister of France|French Prime Minister]] [[Jean Castex]] announces that [[France]] will lift their requirements for [[COVID-19 vaccine passport|COVID-19 vaccine passports]] in access venues beginning on March 14. [https://amp.france24.com/en/live-news/20220303-france-to-suspend-rules-requiring-covid-19-vaccine-passes-on-march-14 (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Estonia]]
****[[President of Estonia|Estonian President]] [[Alar Karis]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://news.err.ee/1608519005/estonian-president-tests-positive-for-covid (ERR)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
****[[Hong Kong]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 56,827 new COVID-19 cases, thereby bringing the total of confirmed cases in the territory to 350,557. The territory also reporting a record 144 deaths in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the death toll in territory to 1,366. [https://amp.scmp.com/news/hong-kong/health-environment/article/3169054/coronavirus-hong-kong-500-sample-collection (''South China Morning Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kazakhstan]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Kazakhstan]]
****[[Kazakhstan]] begins its production of the [[Sputnik Light]] [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://www.inform.kz/en/kazakhstan-starts-sputnik-light-covid-19-vaccine-production_a3906851/amp (Kazinform)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indiana]]
****[[Indiana]] [[Governor of Indiana|Governor]] [[Eric Holcomb]] signs an executive order ending the state’s COVID-19 emergency. [https://www.indystar.com/story/news/politics/2022/03/03/house-bill-1001-gov-holcomb-ends-indiana-covid-public-health-emergency/9365052002/ (''The Indianapolis Star'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
***[[New Zealand]] reports a record 23,183 new community transmitted COVID-19 cases in the past 24 hours. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/covid-19-omicron-outbreak-covid-cases-hit-23183-peak-expected-in-week-or-two/6ULRJWVWJBFD5EADX5DAQWZQ5Y/ (''New Zealand Herald'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Reactions to the 2021–2022 Russo-Ukrainian crisis]], [[International reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russia–Ukraine relations]]
***[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] says that the second round of talks between [[Ukraine]] and [[Russia]] have begun. [https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/world/second-round-of-ukraine-russia-talks-to-take-place-today-374793 (''The Tribune India'')]
***Ukrainian presidential adviser Mykhailo Podolyak says that Ukraine and Russia have not "achieved the desired results they wanted", but that Russia has agreed to a temporary ceasefire in humanitarian corridors, thereby allowing more time for civilian evacuations. Both sides are expected to hold a third round of talks beginning next week. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-says-talks-with-russia-agreed-humanitarian-corridors-2022-03-03/ (Reuters)] [https://www.forexlive.com/news/ukrainian-negotiator-russia-and-ukraine-agree-to-hold-a-third-round-of-talks-20220303/ (Forexlive)]
***President Zelenskyy calls for a personal meeting with [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] in an effort to end the war. [https://www.marketwatch.com/story/zelensky-appeals-to-putin-for-meeting-i-dont-bite-says-the-ukraine-president-01646326567 (MarketWatch)]
*[[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**[[Iran–Saudi Arabia relations]]
***[[Saudi Arabia|Saudi]] [[Crown Prince of Saudi Arabia|Crown Prince]] [[Mohammed bin Salman]] says that his country will continue talks with regional rival [[Iran]] in order to reach an agreement between the two countries. Bin Salman also reaffirms his support for a "strong" nuclear deal that would prevent Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/saudi-arabia-hopes-reach-agreement-with-iran-crown-prince-2022-03-03/ (Reuters)]
**[[Iran–United States relations]]
***[[Principal Deputy Spokesperson for the United States Department of State|U.S. State Department principal deputy spokesperson]] [[Jalina Porter]] says that efforts to revive the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|2015 Iran nuclear deal]] have made "significant progress" but urges Iran not to wait any longer. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/us-says-iran-nuke-deal-close-but-difficult-hurdles-remain/amp/ (''Times of Israel'')]
*[[Potential enlargement of the European Union]]
**[[Prime Minister of Georgia]] [[Irakli Garibashvili]] signs a letter to formally apply for membership in the [[European Union]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/georgia-formally-applies-for-eu-membership-pm-01646316907?refsec=afp-news (''Barron's'')]
**[[President of Moldova|Moldovan President]] [[Maia Sandu]] announces that Moldova is formally applying for EU membership. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-699251 (''Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Enlargement of NATO]]
**The [[Assembly of the Republic of Kosovo]] approves a resolution urgently requesting the government to begin negotiations for the country's entry into [[NATO]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/kosovo-parliament-urges-government-start-nato-membership-bid-2022-03-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[International reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[France|French]] authorities seize the [[yacht]] of [[Russian oligarch]] [[Igor Sechin]] in [[La Ciotat]] after the [[European Union]] blacklisted Sechin and froze his assets. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-europe-60582327 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Armenian presidential election]]
**The [[National Assembly (Armenia)|Armenian National Assembly]] elects [[Vahagn Khachaturyan]] in a second round as the new country's [[President of Armenia|President]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/armenia-khachatrian-elected-president/31734110.html (RFE/RL)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[International reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Media freedom in the European Union]], [[Censorship in the United Kingdom]]
***[[Mass media in Russia|Russian television network]] [[RT (TV network)|RT]] is taken off-air in the EU and the [[United Kingdom]] due to its coverage of the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/entertainment-arts-60584092 (BBC News)]
**[[RT America]] ceases production and fires most of its employees. It expects the layoff to be permanent. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/03/03/media/rt-america-layoffs/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2022 in archosaur paleontology]]
**A new research published in the [[Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology]] shows that the [[Stegosauria|stegosaur]] [[Bashanosaurus]], also known as the ''Bashanosaurus primitivus'', is the oldest dinosaur species to be discovered in [[Asia]]. [https://phys.org/news/2022-03-species-stegosaur-oldest-asia-possibly.html (Phys.org)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on sports]]
**[[2022 NFL season]]
***The [[National Football League]] and [[National Football League Players Association]] announce that they will eliminate [[COVID-19 testing]] and other protocols for the 2022 season following a revision to U.S. CDC guidelines and a decline in the number of COVID-19 cases. [https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/33413223/nfl-suspends-covid-19-protocols-cites-decreasing-spread (ESPN)]
*[[Boycott of Russia and Belarus]]
**[[UEFA]] announces that they have banned [[Belarus]] from [[Football Federation of Belarus|hosting]] international games due to [[Belarusian involvement in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|its role]] in the invasion of Ukraine. [https://bleacherreport.com/articles/10028559-uefa-bars-belarus-from-hosting-international-games-after-invasion-of-ukraine (Bleacher Report)]
